transcript: Speaker A: पड़ोसी के बच्चे इंग्लिश बोल रहे हैं, आपका बच्चा चुप है। आपको बुरा लगता है मैं समझ सकती हूँ... [Neighbor's kids speak English while yours stays quiet. I understand it hurts, but worrying won't help; taking action will. Give it a month. Children find English hard because of boring methods like rote learning and punishment. Download the Seekho app and open the General English show. The first video is 'Start with Hello', watched by over 100k people. It explains in simple Hindi. Teach them polite words like please and thank you to build confidence, followed by 10 daily sentences. For practice, I am their AI coach. I will patiently correct them without judgment. You can also learn together, making it a bonding game. In a month, your child will start speaking English confidently. Download the Seekho app today.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click the install button and download the Seekho app.]

summary: An AI robot presenter addresses parents whose children struggle with English compared to fluent peers. She promotes the Seekho app as a fun, stress-free alternative to traditional rote learning, featuring an interactive AI coach to practice speaking. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
